claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Ligent 後續公告、業績或客戶端文件寫出 ELSFP 改用外購雷射，或 100 mW ELSFP 商用中止。核查頻率：每半年。觸發後 48 小時：e1 的 claim 降 confidence，重讀外部光源層「誰自製雷射」那一句。
claims.statement: Ligent Technologies' own CIOE 2026 release (2026-09-07): its ELSFP external light source features 'self‑developed CW lasers'; 'the 100 mW ELSFP has achieved initial commercialization', with a 400 mW ELSFP demonstrated; the company describes a full chain from CW lasers to ELSFP to NPO/CPO. Issuer self-report (L8 weak), same origin as Broadcom's partner listing of LIGENT only in subject — no customer, volume or qualification named here.

source_doc.title: Ligent Technologies 官網新聞稿〈CIOE 2026 … Featuring NPO/XPO and High‑Power Lasers〉節錄：ELSFP 用自研 CW 雷射、100 mW ELSFP 初步商用

sources.quote: Paired with the ELSFP external light source solution featuring self‑developed CW lasers, it delivers a complete NPO optical interconnect solution tailored for high‑density and low‑power‑consumption scenarios.
In terms of light source product lines, the 100 mW ELSFP has achieved initial commercialization, while the brand‑new 400 mW ultra‑high‑power ELSFP will be demonstrated on‑site at the exhibition.

Ligent Technologies’ self‑developed lasers feature high output power, high efficiency and superior stability. They lay a solid light‑source foundation for ELSFP, NPO/CPO silicon photonics applications, completing the full technical chain spanning CW lasers, ELSFP external light sources down to NPO/CPO deployments.
